_about: The one list of what you can say to the assistant. The phone's Commands screen and the brain both read this file. When a feature ships, flip its status from "coming" to "live". Commands with a "plugin" field only appear when that plugin is on.

commands.does: Wakes the assistant (only for your voice). Then ask anything.
Talk without saying the wake word.
Anything current: weather, news, scores, prices, opening hours. the assistant looks it up.

commands.say: Remember that my gym is closed Sundays
commands.does: The assistant keeps the fact for future conversations.
Reads your next seven days from the phone calendar.
Adds the event with a 10-minute alert.

commands.say: Remind me at 5 to call Mom
commands.does: Adds a timed reminder to your calendar.
A running to-do / shopping list. "What's on my list?" reads it back; "I bought the milk" crosses it off; "Clear the list" empties it.

commands.say: Remind me when I get home to call the bank
commands.does: A reminder that fires when you arrive somewhere.
Sender and gist of what's new, across your mailboxes.
Searches your mail by person or topic.
Reads the email in full.
Saves a DRAFT for you to send. the assistant never sends email.

commands.say: What did the cleanup do today?
commands.does: The cleanup runs every hour, 6 AM to 10 PM, and moves clear junk (promos, newsletters, social) out of Outlook's Other tab and Gmail's Promotions / Social / Updates into a "<name> cleaned" folder. This tells you what it moved, and why.
Moves everything it cleared today back to your inbox.
A text from someone in your contacts is read aloud. Spam and unknown numbers are skipped.
Answers the text the assistant just read. the assistant reads the words back and asks "Shall I send it?". Say yes.
Answers anyone who texted you today, even hours later.

commands.say: Text Sarah I'm on my way
commands.does: A new text to anyone in your contacts, e.g. while driving. Read back, then you say yes.
Computer idle for 3 minutes: a thread that finishes or asks you something is announced by its own name (e.g. "your Growth thread"). Touch the computer and it goes back to the screen.
Announce threads even if the computer isn't idle.
Ends heading-out mode and hands waiting threads back to the screen.

commands.say: What are my threads up to?
commands.does: Your pinned threads first: which are waiting on you, questions you haven't answered yet, and what each last said.

commands.say: Tell the Growth thread to pause the ads
commands.does: Any thread, any time, by its name, waiting or not. Needs the relay running on your computer (docs/PLUGINS.md).

commands.say: Answer the Job Applications question: yes
commands.does: Answer a thread's question later, even hours after it asked. The thread gets your answer with its question attached.
Say your wake phrase five times after the chime; the assistant then wakes only for you.
The assistant wakes for anyone again.
Briefing: today's calendar, email that needs you, what the cleanup cleared, texts that came in overnight, waiting Claude threads, anything due soon. Also ends sleep mode.

commands.say: I'm going to sleep, don't disturb me till 6
commands.does: Turns on Do Not Disturb until then (your usual DND exceptions still ring) and the assistant goes quiet: no texts read, no Claude threads. No time given = 6 AM.
Ends sleep mode early and turns Do Not Disturb off. "Good morning" does it too.
Missed and declined calls from the last day, contacts first. Also in the morning briefing. (Voicemail messages stay in your carrier voicemail app.)
When the phone connects to your car's Bluetooth, the assistant goes hands-free: texts are read at any hour and Claude threads are announced while you drive. It turns off when the car disconnects.
Say it while connected if car mode didn't switch on by itself: the assistant remembers that Bluetooth device as your car.
Switch it by hand.
Your Samsung TV, from the phone over your home Wi-Fi (home only). The first time, press Allow on the TV. Turning it on needs the TV's "Power On with Mobile" setting.
Opens the app on the TV, switching the TV on first. Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, YouTube, Hulu, Max, Apple TV, Peacock and Spotify. Opens the app; it can't pick a show yet.
Controls whatever is playing on the TV, like the remote: pause, play, skip back or ahead (10 seconds per step, e.g. "skip ahead a minute"), Home, Back, OK.

Every hour the assistant reads the receipts, invoices and refunds in your mail and tells you about a new one, e.g. "Anthropic charged $40 for auto-recharge credits". A failed payment or a bill due is called out too. Held while you sleep; the morning briefing covers it.

commands.say: What did I spend this week?
commands.does: Total and the biggest charges by name, from your receipts. Also "this month", "on AWS", "on Claude".
Stops the spoken heads-up for new charges; "What did I spend?" still works. "Turn charge alerts back on" undoes it.
